title: Explorer section tabs
responsibility: Renders a selectable horizontal strip of explorer sections.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.view
inputs.description: The selected tab id; it is compared with each item.id to set aria-selected and reveal the selected item. View is a string subtype, and the component does not validate that it matches an available tab.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.onview
inputs.description: Called with the tab id when a button tab is activated or a link tab receives a plain click. The component does not call it for other link clicks.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.tabs
inputs.description: When omitted, the component uses the built-in map, compare, history, growth, and activity tabs; an empty array renders no tabs. Each item.id is the keyed-list key, and an item with a truthy href is rendered as a link only when it is not disabled; all other items render as buttons.

inputs.name: HarnessTabs.label
inputs.description: Accessible name passed to the tablist aria-label attribute without transformation. It defaults to the literal string Views.

outputs.name: HarnessTabs
outputs.description: Renders a tablist with one tab per configured or built-in item: enabled items with a truthy href are links, and all others are buttons; selection is determined by view === item.id. Effects update overflow state and adjust only the strip scroll position to reveal the selected tab; a horizontal-scroll note appears when scrollWidth exceeds clientWidth by more than 1px.

errors.name: Duplicate tab key
errors.description: The keyed each block uses item.id as its key, so duplicate tab ids cause a keyed-list error during rendering or updating.

errors.name: Caller callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by onview during a button activation or plain link click propagates from the event handler.
